tour_blurb: Twenty-eight houses Security and the Vault. Credentials, keys, and sensitive references live here behind strict access rules — no floor reads from the Vault directly, every request travels by sealed lift packet. The guardians on this floor take their work seriously, and we're grateful they do.
concierge_blurb: Security & Vault. Sensitive references are kept behind sealed-packet access only — no floor reads directly. A dashboard deny-guard watches every endpoint and logs anything off-pattern.
lessons_learned_for_next_agent: F28 floor_card lives at the floor root — never inside vault/. The card must NEVER list credential names, env file paths, or any contents of vault/; vault_present=true is the signal, the actual references stay sealed. visitor_open=false because the floor itself is back-of-house, even though the tour_blurb is concierge-narrated for the open-day walkthrough. The deny-guard signal points at qsb_dashboard_security_audit.jsonl — that log is the visitor-safe proof the gate is alive, not the gate's contents.

team_roster.role: owns floor: keeps room schema current, tracks worker headcount, stamps daily activity, escalates to Wren+Hermes
